BearerAuth.description: Configured service token. Paste the token without the Bearer prefix into Authorize.

SessionCookie.description: Browser session cookies are also accepted. Cookie requests require Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin or none, and writes additionally require X-Unflatten-Client: web. Send exactly one credential: a Bearer token or a session cookie; sending both is rejected. Browser-managed HttpOnly cookie; Swagger cannot set it manually.
SessionCookie.name: unflatten_session

info.description: Private asynchronous PDF/image conversion service. Authorize with a configured Bearer token, submit a conversion, poll status_url, then download available artifacts. Browser session cookies are also accepted. Cookie requests require Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin or none, and writes additionally require X-Unflatten-Client: web. Send exactly one credential: a Bearer token or a session cookie; sending both is rejected.
info.title: Unflatten private diagnostic service

post.description: Authentication and required headers are checked before upload bytes are read. A 202 response admits an asynchronous job; it does not mean conversion succeeded. Follow status_url (also returned in Location) using GET until state is succeeded, failed, cancelled or expired. On success download only available artifacts from the status response. Stop polling at a client deadline; failed jobs expose a problem, and expired artifacts return 410. diagnostic_docx is a private diagnostic Word output, with no product-quality claim.

parameters.description: Unique visible-ASCII key for this submission. Reuse the same key only to retry the same input and settings. In this service's Swagger UI only, 'auto' is replaced with a fresh UUID on each Execute; headless clients must supply their own key. The server treats 'auto' as an ordinary literal key.

get.description: Poll the owner's job until succeeded, failed, cancelled or expired. Inspect artifact availability before downloading; terminal state alone does not promise a Word artifact. If-None-Match is supported and may return 304. Use a polling deadline.

get.description:
Design §3.6: `artifacts.zip` -- every downloadable artifact the caller's
capabilities permit, bundled with a `MANIFEST.json`.

Requires job ownership and the artifact's download capability. Only published artifacts of succeeded, unexpired jobs are available. Page indices are zero-based; whole-document prediction_ir returns page 0 for multi-page input. Word is the assembled document. ZIP includes permitted artifacts and MANIFEST.json; expired artifacts return 410.

Content-Disposition.description: attachment; filename identifies the downloaded artifact.

default.description: Problem response (authentication, capability, ownership, availability or expiry).

get.summary: List model variants and command status

put.description:
Design §3.9: `PUT /v1/models/default {variant_id}` -- `null` clears
the user override (falls back to config/auto); an unknown variant is a
422; never touches `runtime_policy` (`policy_hash` is unaffected).

variant_id.description: Published variant_id from GET /v1/models, or null to clear the override and restore config/auto selection.

put.summary: Set or clear the default model variant

delete.description:
Design §3.9: `DELETE /v1/models/{variant_id}/download`. The resident
variant is refused (`409 MODEL_COMMAND_CONFLICT`, `ModelCommandExecutor
._run_delete`'s own second safety net mirrors this at the worker); a
local `bundle` variant has no snapshot to delete (`422
MODEL_VARIANT_NOT_DOWNLOADABLE`, same reason as `download`).
delete.summary: Queue removal of a model download

post.description:
Design §3.9: `POST /v1/models/{variant_id}/download`. A local `bundle`
variant has nothing to download -- `422 MODEL_VARIANT_NOT_DOWNLOADABLE`.

Design §3.9/§17.5: `POST /v1/models/{variant_id}/load`. Same
fit/engine gates as `_resolve_model_variant`'s submit-time checks: a
variant too big for the card is `422 MODEL_VARIANT_DOES_NOT_FIT`, an
engine this worker cannot (yet) run is `422 MODEL_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE`.
